entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""So... Your Majesty. You are aware..."
entries.dialogueText: "So... Your Majesty. You are aware that nobody in Lespia nor our alliance supports this visit."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "We eased to a stop at the entrance..."
entries.dialogueText: We eased to a stop at the entrance of the Yellow House. I stepped out onto the cobblestone driveway. The building itself was a small but imposing structure of classical design, its yellow-painted walls standing out boldly against the greenery of the park.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Our convoy commenced its journey, a..."
entries.dialogueText: Our convoy commenced its journey, a series of sleek black cars gliding through the Lespian capital's bustling streets.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "When we arrived in Perla, the press..."
entries.dialogueText: When we arrived in Perla, the press surged forward at me like a relentless horde -- shoving their cameras and microphones my way.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I stood there, absorbed in thoug..."
entries.dialogueText: As I stood there, absorbed in thought, the doors opened and Prime Minister Alvarez came in.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I started inspecting the teapot."
entries.dialogueText: I started inspecting the teapot.
entries.menuText: Inspect the teapot.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "The elegantly crafted vessel was en..."
entries.dialogueText: The elegantly crafted vessel was engraved with intricate designs -- delicate floral patterns interwoven with abstract shapes that reminded me of medieval Rezenid motifs.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "As I waited for Prime Minister Alva..."
entries.dialogueText: As I waited for Prime Minister Alvarez, my attention was captured by a mysterious-looking teapot, resplendent in its golden sheen.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "Their shouts and pleas for attentio..."
entries.dialogueText: Their shouts and pleas for attention clashed with the stoic demeanor of the Lespian security guards. These guards, clad in crisp, dark uniforms, formed a protective barrier around us, their eyes scanning for any reporter daring enough to breach their formation.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I was led into the waiting room --..."
entries.dialogueText: I was led into the waiting room -- a space with an understated elegance, furnished with leather chairs and a mahogany table. Sunlight filtered through lace curtains, casting soft patterns on the floor.

entries.speaker: Player_Romus_Italic
entries.title: Player_Romus_Italic: "I left it alone."
entries.dialogueText: I left it alone.
entries.menuText: Leave it alone.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I leaned in closer, observing the w..."
entries.dialogueText: I leaned in closer, observing the way the light played off its surface. The piece was definitely made out of Rizian gold and looked far too ancient for its well-maintained shape.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "I wondered if it was an original Ri..."
entries.dialogueText: I wondered if it was an original Rizian artifact or an unrelated gift from another foreign dignitary. Whatever it was, I questioned why such a valuable artifact was left out in the open like this.

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "But then again, those who were allo..."
entries.dialogueText: But then again, those who were allowed into this room -- world leaders and people of stature -- would probably have the common sense not to disturb this priceless relic.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""I see you immediately spotted your..."
entries.dialogueText: "I see you immediately spotted your kingdom's gold, Your Majesty."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""It is an ancient Rezenid artifact,..."
entries.dialogueText: "It is an ancient Rezenid artifact, uncovered in southern Lespia. Quite a valuable item, I've been told."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "He offered his hand and I shook it."
entries.dialogueText: He offered his hand and I shook it.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Ah. Forgive me.""
entries.dialogueText: "Ah. Forgive me."

entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""Please. Let's get comfortable whil..."
entries.dialogueText: "Please. Let's get comfortable while we discuss our matters."

entries.speaker: Narrator
entries.title: Narrator: "On his gesture, we moved to the sof..."
entries.dialogueText: On his gesture, we moved to the sofas and sat down.

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""But since I still see Rizia as a p..."
entries.dialogueText: "But since I still see Rizia as a potential partner in the region, I'm showing my respects to you."

entries.dialogueText: "Lespia does not approve of your invasion. And unless that reality does not change, there is not much I can offer you."

entries.speaker: Patricio Alvarez
entries.title: Patricio Alvarez (R): ""...But I guess you knew that alrea..."
entries.dialogueText: "...But I guess you knew that already."
